meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 它把 Google Chat 适配器从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/，加上注册导入，安装 @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0，再构建并跑注册测试，让 NanoClaw 能接入 Google Chat。凭据部分仍需你在 Google Cloud Console 手动配置。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 加上 Google Chat 渠道时执行；在 /setup 流程中或之后运行，完成后回到 /setup，或用 /manage-channels 把该渠道接到 agent group。

say.text: 帮我加上 Google Chat 渠道
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册、装依赖、构建并跑测试

say.text: 把服务账号 JSON 存成 GCHAT_CREDENTIALS
say.note: 它会提示你粘贴单行 JSON 并写入 .env

say.text: 把 gchat 渠道接到我的 agent group

howto.what_en: Copies the Google Chat adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0, builds and runs the registration test. Credentials need manual Google Cloud setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Google Chat channel to NanoClaw; run it during or after /setup, then return to /setup or use /manage-channels to wire it to an agent group.

say_en.text: Add the Google Chat channel for me
say_en.note: Copies, registers, installs, builds and tests

say_en.text: Store the service account JSON as GCHAT_CREDENTIALS
say_en.note: Prompts you to paste a one-line JSON into .env

say_en.text: Wire the gchat channel to my agent group
